The '''64th Directors Guild of America Awards''', honoring the outstanding directorial achievements in [[film director|film]]s, [[documentary film|documentary]] and [[television director|television]] in 2011, were presented on January 28, 2012, at the [[Hollywood and Highland Center]].<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title='The Artist' tops DGA Awards|url=https://variety.com/2012/film/awards/the-artist-tops-dga-awards-1118049423/|access-date=January 20, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 28, 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite news|last1=Kilday|first1=Gregg|title=Directors Guild of America Awards 2012: Complete Winners List|url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/race/dga-awards-winners-directors-guild-nominations-285487|access-date=20 January 2018|work=The Hollywood Reporter|date=January 28, 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Michel Hazanavicius wins DGA Feature Film Award for "The Artist." Other winners of 2011 DGA Awards announced. |url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2012/0128-DGA-Awards-Winners.aspx |publisher=Directors Guild of America |access-date=August 9, 2018 |date=January 28, 2012}}</ref> The ceremony was hosted by [[Kelsey Grammer]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Kelsey Grammer to Host 64th Annual DGA Awards|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2011/1219-Kelsey-Grammer-to-Host-64th-Annual-DGA-Awards.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=December 19, 2011}}</ref> The nominees for the feature film category were announced on January 9, 2012,<ref>{{cite web|last1=Knegt|first1=Peter|title=Directors Guild of America Announces 2011 DGA Award Nominees|url=https://www.indiewire.com/2012/01/directors-guild-of-america-announces-2011-dga-award-nominees-49954/|website=IndieWire|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 9, 2012}}</ref> the nominations for the television and commercial categories were announced on January 10, 2012,<ref>{{cite web|title=64th Annual DGA Awards Television Nominees Announced|url=https://www.dga.org/News/PressReleases/2012/0110-DGA-Awards-Announcement-TV-Nominations.aspx|publisher=Directors Guild of America|access-date=January 21, 2018|date=January 10, 2012}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|title=DGA Announces TV & Commercials Nominees|url=https://deadline.com/2012/01/dga-announces-tv-commericals-nominees-212695/|website=Deadline Hollywood|access-date=January 20, 2018|date=January 10, 2012}}</ref> and the nominees for documentary directing were announced on January 12, 2012.<ref>{{cite news|last1=McNary|first1=Dave|title=DGA noms high-profile documentaries|url=https://variety.com/2012/film/awards/dga-noms-high-profile-documentaries-1118048524/|access-date=January 20, 2018|work=Variety|date=January 12, 2012}}</ref>
